text: If it is a well-known fact that I opposed air pollution laws in California, the only thing I can possibly think of is that the President must be suggesting the law that the Federal Government tried to impose on the State of California - not a law, but regulations
speaker: REAGAN

text: that would have made it impossible to drive an automobile within the city limits of any California city, or to have a place to put it if you did drive it against their regulations
speaker: REAGAN

text: We still have the strictest air control, or air pollution laws in the country
speaker: REAGAN
